title: Batiste, Amos Riley and the clarinets
summary: Clarifying the order of Batiste and Amos Riley; Vincent talks about clarinet keys and Willie Humphrey.

blocks.x: Ask him if this was before he was with Amos Riley or Amos Riley.

He said, was this before you was with Amos Riley? Yeah, I had to play with Amos Riley too. No, he said, was you with Batiste before Amos Riley? Oh, no way after. Amos Riley Dive used to call him Slim or stick something. Used to call him Slim for a nickname, you know. But Willie Humphrey, you know, over there, he was Willie too, and that was Slim. And Brian Freddie. Slim had to get a lioness. He didn't get a lioness, but he never had to hold him up, you know. Then he had a horn, he had two shanks. They didn't get him no more hands. You know, he got to pull out and tune up. Put in, like that. And they used to use three clarinets. A, B, and C. And probably couldn't make, play in all kinds of keys. And that's a, they have all three dimensions, you know, to play, you know.
Who was he with before he was with Amos Riley?
I didn't, who was you with before you went with Amos Riley? Yeah. Put the long seat.
Don't want to turn it off a minute if you want to. No, that's not bothering me.
Just my footmark. That's with my band. After my band broke up, then they grabbed me on the counter, you know, blind Freddie.
